newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ROMANIA VS IRELAND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ROMANIA VS IRELAND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup group eight qualifier between Romania and Ireland on Wednesday:

Romania - 23-Bogdan Stelea; 2-Dan Petrescu, 3-Daniel Prodan, 4-Anton Dobos, 5-Iilian Filipescu, 6-Gheorghe Popescu, 7-Dorinel Munteanu, 8-Adrian Ilie, 9-Viorel Moldovan, 10-Gheorghe Hagi, 11-Tibor Selymess.
Ireland - 1-Alan Kelly; 2-Denis Irwin, 3-Steve Staunton, 4-Kenny Cunningham, 5-Ian Harte, 6-Roy Keane, 7-Andy Townsend, 8-Ray Houghton, 9-Mark Kennedy, 10-Garry Kelly, 11-David Connolly.
